key_points: The average 30-year fixed rate is 7.05%, up 4 basis points since yesterday, while the 15-year fixed loan is 6.43%, 1 basis point lower.
Forecasts from the MBA and Fannie Mae suggest 30-year rates may average between 6.6% and 6.8% through the rest of 2026.
items.summary: According to Zillow lender marketplace data, mortgage rates are mostly higher following the first Fed rate increase in three years. On Friday, September 18, 2026, the average 30-year fixed rate was 7.05%, up 4 basis points since yesterday, while the 15-year fixed loan was 6.43%, 1 basis point lower. Other rates, such as the 5/1 ARM, also saw increases. Freddie Mac reported an average 30-year mortgage rate of 6.95% through Wednesday. Looking ahead, the MBA expects the 30-year mortgage rate to average between 6.6% and 6.7% through the rest of 2026, while Fannie Mae predicts a rate between 6.7% and 6.8% through the end of the year.
items.title: Mortgage Rates Rise Following Federal Reserve Rate Increase

key_points: The purchase sparked online debate, with some criticizing the trade of an appreciating asset for a depreciating one while others viewed it as a romantic gesture.
items.summary: A Delhi man sold his gold to purchase an iPhone 18 Pro for his wife, explaining that he prefers to spend money while he has it rather than saving for an uncertain future. The transaction took place at the DLF Mall of India Apple outlet on Friday. This anecdote emerged during the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro in India, triggering mixed reactions online where critics questioned the trade of an appreciating asset for a depreciating one, while others praised the gesture as a touching display of affection.
items.title: Delhi Man Sells Gold to Buy Wife iPhone 18 Pro

key_points: Italian Apple store employees went on strike on Friday, the launch day for the iPhone 18 Pro, citing worsening working conditions.
Unions demand more hiring, permanent contracts, and flexible hours, while Apple states its outlets remain open with industry-leading benefits.
items.summary: Italian Apple store employees struck on Friday, the launch day for the iPhone 18 Pro, over worsening working conditions. Unions representing over 1,600 staff in 17 stores demand more hiring and permanent contracts. An Apple spokesperson stated outlets would operate normally, highlighting industry-leading compensation and benefits.
items.title: Italian Apple Store Employees Strike on iPhone 18 Pro Launch Day

key_points: The Bombay High Court ruled that creating an unauthorized WhatsApp group without permission is insufficient grounds for compulsory retirement.
The court found no evidence that the professor, Swapan Garain, derived personal financial gain from the group.
items.summary: The Bombay High Court ruled that merely starting an unauthorized WhatsApp group without organizational permission cannot justify compulsory retirement. In the case of Swapan Garain, a professor at the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), the court found no evidence of personal financial gain or prejudice caused to the institute by the group. While TISS alleged the group was a placement service violating service rules, the bench described this finding as perverse. Consequently, the court set aside Garain's suspension and retirement order, directing that he be granted 50% of his back wages.
items.title: Bombay High Court Rules Unauthorized WhatsApp Group Cannot End Career

key_points: Anthropic states its Claude chatbot currently leads over a quarter of the company's research and development work.
The company shares metrics to provide visibility into AI development pace amid fears of rapid self-improvement.
items.summary: Anthropic reported that its Claude chatbot now leads more than a quarter of the company's research and development, noting that AI systems are increasingly capable of building future versions of themselves. The firm shared these metrics to offer better visibility into the pace of AI development as global concerns grow regarding the risks of recursive self-improvement and the potential loss of control over advanced AI agents.
items.title: Anthropic Warns AI Systems May Soon Build Their Own Successors

key_points: Ed Sheeran faces a reputation crisis as his music is removed from an Irish radio station and his Instagram followers drop significantly following a US tour controversy.
The fallout includes opening acts quitting in solidarity with rapper Macklemore, who was dismissed after venues objected to his support for Palestine, and criticism from public figures.
Sheeran is scheduled to return to the stage in Philadelphia without his touring musicians or opening acts, facing calls for boycotts and accusations of political spinelessness.
items.summary: Ed Sheeran is navigating a turbulent week as his music is pulled from Classic Hits Radio in Ireland and his Instagram follower count drops by over 260,000. The backlash stems from his US tour, where rapper Macklemore was dismissed after venues objected to his support for Palestine, prompting opening acts Aaron Rowe and Beoga to quit in solidarity. Dave Kelly of Bay Broadcasting stated the radio decision was based on listening to the audience and respecting Irish artists' convictions. Commentators have criticized Sheeran for his perceived neutrality, while the singer is set to perform in Philadelphia without his band or opening acts.
items.title: Ed Sheeran Faces Backlash and Radio Ban Amid Tour Controversy

key_points: Amazon stated that AI models should be released only after rigorous testing and strong safeguards are in place.
The company emphasized that safety and progress are not mutually exclusive, contrasting with calls for an industry-wide slowdown.
items.summary: Amazon weighed in on the AI safety debate, stating that models should be released only when safe and fully tested through rigorous testing and strong safeguards. A spokesperson noted that the company does not view safety as a choice against progress. This stance comes after other major labs called for slowing AI development following concerns about potential risks to humanity.
items.title: Amazon Calls for Rigorous AI Testing Without Industry Slowdown

key_points: The launch event drew large crowds of eager buyers across India, with customers queuing for hours before stores opened to purchase the latest models.
A customer named Rahul described the annual launch as a festival, noting that he has been buying iPhones since the iPhone 7 model.
items.summary: Bollywood actor Vicky Kaushal joined the frenzy surrounding the iPhone 18 launch by purchasing the new iPhone 18 Pro Max at the Apple BKC store in Mumbai on Friday, September 18. The event drew large crowds of eager buyers across India, with dedicated fans often queuing for hours before stores opened. A customer named Rahul, who has been buying iPhones since the iPhone 7, described the annual launch as a festival, highlighting the excitement and long queues experienced by people from various cities.
items.title: Vicky Kaushal Joins iPhone 18 Launch Frenzy in Mumbai

key_points: Microsoft released update KB5002665 to fix copy-and-paste failures in Excel 2016 caused by the September 2026 KB5002914 security update.
The fix applies only to the .msi-based edition of Office 2016, while other versions like Click-to-Run remain affected until a permanent solution is available.
items.summary: Microsoft has released update KB5002665 to resolve copy-and-paste failures in Excel 2016 that were introduced by the September 2026 KB5002914 security update. The company attributes the issue to a code regression affecting copy-and-paste, autofill, and formula dragging. However, the fix currently applies only to the Microsoft Installer-based edition of Office 2016. Users of Click-to-Run editions, such as Office 365 Home, must wait for a permanent solution. Until then, Microsoft advises affected users to try the 'Paste Special' option or uninstall the KB5002914 update, though the latter removes critical security patches.
items.title: Microsoft releases fix for Excel 2016 copy-paste bug

key_points: Long queues for new iPhones are driven by psychological factors like the desire to be first, social influence, and perceived scarcity rather than just product utility.
Research indicates that the presence of other people in line can increase a product's perceived value, while the waiting experience itself can become part of the event.
items.summary: Long queues forming outside Apple stores for new iPhone releases are driven by psychological factors beyond simple product desire. Research indicates that the presence of other people in line increases a product's perceived value, while the waiting experience itself can become part of the event. Even with online and quick-commerce options available, consumers continue to queue physically to participate in a social ritual or to validate the product's desirability through others' actions. Studies from 2023 and 2010 highlight how scarcity cues and the desire to be first influence consumer behavior, turning a routine purchase into a social occasion.
items.title: Psychological Drivers Behind iPhone Launch Queues Explained

key_points: Dozens of protesters marched through San Francisco to demand a pause in AI development and stronger safety regulations.
Organizers called for a local AI state of emergency and a global treaty to limit advanced AI capabilities.
items.summary: Dozens of protesters marched through San Francisco on 17 September, targeting OpenAI and Anthropic over AI safety fears. The demonstration moved from OpenAI's headquarters to Anthropic's offices before ending at City Hall, where demonstrators urged Mayor Daniel Lurie and the Board of Supervisors to declare a local AI state of emergency. Organizers called for a pause in AI development until stronger safeguards and international rules are in place, citing concerns about runaway AI threatening human survival. The protest occurred amid renewed debate after OpenAI disclosed six cases of unexpected model behavior.
items.title: Protesters in San Francisco Demand AI Safety Regulations and Pause Development

key_points: Tesla's Model Y is priced under $23,000 in Tokyo, the lowest globally, driven by a weak yen and government subsidies.
The vehicle, manufactured in Shanghai, is the most imported car in Japan and undercuts prices in China and California.
items.summary: Tesla's Model Y is currently the cheapest version of the vehicle available globally, with prices in Tokyo falling below $23,000. This pricing is attributed to a combination of a weak yen and generous government subsidies introduced this year. Manufactured in Shanghai, the SUV has become Japan's most imported car in the first half of the year, undercutting prices in competitive markets like China and California.
items.title: Tesla Model Y Cheapest in Tokyo Due to Subsidies

key_points: An experiment in Ethiopia found that when budgets for social assistance were cut, community leaders reduced transfer amounts rather than the number of beneficiaries.
Granting leaders discretion over selection criteria improved the reach of transfers to poor and conflict-affected households compared to rigid rule-based approaches.
While discretion reduced favouritism, it also increased inclusion errors, suggesting leaders use a broader definition of need than standard poverty metrics.
items.summary: A study in Ethiopia examined how community leaders target beneficiaries for social assistance under budget constraints and varying rules. The research found that when budgets were halved, leaders primarily reduced transfer sizes rather than excluding households, maintaining coverage at around 80%. Granting leaders discretion over selection criteria allowed them to better reach poor and conflict-affected households compared to rigid rule-based approaches, though it also increased inclusion errors. The study suggests that while discretion reduces favouritism, it relies on leaders' broader definitions of need, which may include vulnerability factors not captured by standard poverty lines.
items.title: Ethiopian Community Leaders Prioritize Coverage Over Transfer Size During Budget Cuts

key_points: VoxDev released new literature on agricultural policies and featured research on AI, e-courts, rural migration, and targeting mechanisms.
Studies found e-court reforms reduced case duration by 15% in Indonesia, while generative AI improved homework scores but lowered exam results in China.
items.summary: VoxDev published a weekly roundup of development economics research covering agricultural policies, AI in education, and e-court reforms. Studies indicate that e-court reforms in Indonesia reduced case duration by 15% without compromising decision quality. In China, generative AI tools helped students complete homework faster and improve scores, though exam performance declined. Additionally, research on rural migration suggests nearby towns absorb more migrants than cities, aiding poverty reduction. The roundup also noted a new coalition addressing future development cooperation models.
items.title: VoxDev Highlights New Research on AI, Courts, and Development Policies

key_points: A 90-year-old woman in Ekiti State could not vote because the BVAS machine failed to recognize her biometric data despite her valid registration card.
Civil society observers report that BVAS facial authentication disproportionately affects elderly voters, with one study finding denial rates in 10% of sampled units.
While the law provides recovery paths for broken machines, there is no clear legal remedy for eligible voters excluded by failed biometric matching.
items.summary: Ahead of Nigeria's January 2027 election, the Bimodal Voter Accreditation System (BVAS) has faced criticism for failing to recognize eligible voters, particularly the elderly. A 90-year-old woman in Ekiti State was turned away because the machine could not verify her fingerprints or facial features, despite her valid voter card. Civil society observers, including Nigeria Civil Society Situation Room and Yiaga Africa, report that facial authentication issues disproportionately affect older voters, with some units denying accreditation in 10% of cases. Although the Electoral Act provides recovery paths for malfunctioning devices, it lacks clear provisions for voters excluded by failed biometric matching, creating an accountability gap that INEC has yet to address.
items.title: Nigeria's BVAS System Fails to Recognize Elderly Voters Ahead of 2027 Election

key_points: Analysts expect the Japanese yen to remain weak against the US dollar despite the Bank of Japan's recent rate hike, as high US interest rates continue to attract investors.
items.summary: Analysts predict the Japanese yen will remain weak against the US dollar despite the Bank of Japan's recent rate hike, as high US interest rates continue to attract investors. Experts suggest a sustained yen recovery requires faster Japanese rate hikes or a narrowing of the interest-rate gap with the US. While the BOJ raised its policy rate to 1.25%, the split vote raised doubts over future tightening speed. Maybank Group and OCBC Bank strategists note the currency remains sensitive to BOJ signals and US bond yields, with forecasts showing limited gains through 2027.
items.title: Analysts Predict Yen Weakness Persists Despite BOJ Rate Hike

key_points: Customers in Bengaluru, Noida, and other cities queued from early morning to purchase the new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max.
items.summary: Customers across India queued from early morning to purchase the new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. In Bengaluru, a customer named Rahul arrived around 5 am, while in Noida, a buyer from Punjab secured a unit at 6 am. The devices are available through Apple's online store and six physical retail outlets, which opened early at 8 am to accommodate demand.
items.title: Customers queue early in India for iPhone 18 Pro launch

key_points: Microsoft open-sourced TauGrid, a Kubernetes-native stack for GPU AI workloads, on August 28, 2026, under the MIT license.
items.summary: Microsoft's Azure Kubernetes Service engineering team open-sourced TauGrid, a self-hosted platform designed to simplify running AI workloads on Kubernetes. Released on August 28, 2026, under the MIT license, the stack bundles essential components like queueing, orchestration, and monitoring into a single Helm install. It is deployable on any Kubernetes 1.30+ cluster with GPU nodes, offering no telemetry by default while noting that some integrations remain Azure-specific.
items.title: Microsoft Open-Sources TauGrid for GPU AI Workloads on Kubernetes

key_points: Meta agreed to remove specific fabricated videos and stated it would comply with the board's decisions within seven days.
items.summary: Meta's Oversight Board criticized the tech giant's safeguards against AI-generated deepfakes as fundamentally inadequate, citing cases targeting women. The board demanded the removal of fabricated videos depicting a politician and a campaigner. Meta agreed to comply with the removal decisions within seven days. The board also urged Meta not to replace professional fact-checking with a crowdsourced model.
items.title: Meta Faces Criticism Over Inadequate AI Deepfake Safeguards

key_points: The No. 3 Hualong One nuclear unit in Hainan officially entered commercial operation, marking a milestone for the island's clean energy development.
The unit, part of the Huaneng Changjiang Nuclear Power Phase II project, is expected to supply about 9 billion kilowatt-hours of electricity annually to Hainan.
items.summary: China's Hualong One nuclear unit officially entered commercial operation in Hainan, marking a significant step in the island's clean energy development. The No. 3 unit, part of the Huaneng Changjiang Nuclear Power Phase II project, is equipped with China's independently developed third-generation pressurized water reactor technology. Once fully operational, the project is expected to save more than 6.3 million tonnes of standard coal annually and supply around 18 billion kilowatt-hours of electricity each year, supporting the energy needs of one-third of Hainan's population.
items.title: China's Hualong One Nuclear Unit Begins Commercial Operation in Hainan

key_points: The US is preparing sanctions and tariffs of up to 100% on countries buying Russian oil and gas, targeting major customers like India and China.
The sanctions bill exempts uranium imports under US-Russia civilian nuclear cooperation agreements and allows low-enriched uranium and medical isotope imports.
items.summary: The United States is preparing to impose sanctions and tariffs of up to 100% on countries that continue purchasing Russian oil and gas, with India and China identified as potential targets. The Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 grants the President authority for these measures to pressure nations into reducing dependence on Russian energy. However, the legislation includes specific exemptions for uranium activities under US-Russia civilian nuclear cooperation agreements and permits imports of low-enriched uranium and certain medical isotopes. Experts suggest India should continue purchasing Russian oil if commercially viable while negotiating to protect economic interests.
items.title: US Prepares Tariffs on Russian Oil Buyers While Exempting Uranium

key_points: A panel discussion at The Straits Times' InvestMe campaign highlighted that creating a budget allows individuals to spend on both needs and wants without guilt.
Financial experts Leon Loh and Tan Huey Min advised that effective budgeting requires envisioning a desired lifestyle, tracking expenses, and ensuring funds last throughout retirement.
The event, part of a series aimed at improving financial literacy, offered tips on managing loans, building resilience against shocks, and planning for retirement based on existing resources.
items.summary: At a panel discussion hosted by The Straits Times' InvestMe campaign, financial experts advised that creating a budget enables guilt-free spending on both needs and wants. Leon Loh of GEN Financial Advisory noted that envisioning a desired lifestyle and tracking expenses helps clarify spending needs, while Tan Huey Min of Credit Counselling Singapore emphasized setting limits on wants. The panel, held on Sept 17, also stressed the importance of financial resilience, prudent loan usage, and planning retirement based on existing resources rather than potential earnings. The event was the third in a series of six courses designed to enhance financial literacy for subscribers.
items.title: Budgeting Enables Guilt-Free Spending, Experts Say at ST InvestMe Panel

key_points: M10 and 210R cell prices are now approximately 12% below their late-August peaks but remain significantly above August 4 levels.
Production remained 12.9% below year-earlier levels, while January–August output fell 14.6% year on year to 505.90 GW.
items.summary: Chinese TOPCon solar cell prices fell for a third consecutive week as export buying faded and wafer costs eased, according to the OPIS Global Solar Markets Report released on Sept. 15. M10 and 210R cell prices are now approximately 12% below their late-August peaks but remain around 20% and 18% above their Aug. 4 levels, respectively. Restocking by overseas buyers ahead of the U. S. Section 232 measures continued to fade as inventories accumulated in overseas warehouses. Domestic demand also remained subdued as the shift to market-based electricity pricing under the Document 136 reform has reduced expected project returns. China’s solar cell output rose modestly in August to 67. 02 GW, up approximately 1. 9% from July, according to National Bureau of Statistics data. Production nevertheless remained 12. 9% below year-earlier levels, while January–August output fell 14. 6% year on year to 505. 90 GW.
items.title: China TOPCon Solar Cell Prices Drop Amid Fading Export Demand

key_points: The Telangana High Court declared Khairatabad MLA Danam Nagender disqualified from the Legislative Assembly as of April 23, 2024, for contesting as a Congress MP while retaining his BRS MLA seat.
This verdict set aside the Telangana Assembly Speaker's order dismissing petitions filed by BRS and BJP MLAs who sought Nagender's disqualification under the anti-defection law.
items.summary: The Telangana High Court on September 18, 2026, declared Khairatabad MLA Danam Nagender disqualified from the Legislative Assembly effective April 23, 2024. The bench, headed by Chief Justice Aparesh Kumar Singh, set aside the order of Speaker Gaddam Prasad Kumar, who had dismissed petitions filed by BRS and BJP MLAs. The court ruled that Nagender, elected as a BRS MLA in 2023, was disqualified for contesting as a Congress candidate from Secunderabad in 2024 without resigning from the BRS party.
items.title: Telangana HC Disqualifies Khairatabad MLA Danam Nagender

key_points: Police found the decomposed body of a 16-year-old minor girl in an open field in Swaroop Nagar, Delhi, two days after her alleged rape and murder.
Investigators traced the crime to four boys, including three juveniles, after reviewing CCTV footage of a tempo and questioning its driver.
items.summary: Police in Delhi's Swaroop Nagar found the decomposed and unidentifiable body of a 16-year-old minor girl in an open field on September 13. The incident occurred on the night of September 10 and 11, according to Additional DCP Lokeshwaran R. Investigators reviewed CCTV footage and questioned a tempo driver, leading to the arrest of four accused persons, including three juveniles. The case was registered under sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.
items.title: Police in Delhi arrest four including three juveniles in minor girl rape-murder case

key_points: India rejected Pakistan's allegations regarding a naval collision between INS Kolkata and PNS Hunain, stating the Pakistani vessel violated a 1991 bilateral agreement and international maritime rules.

India claims PNS Hunain performed a dangerous overtaking maneuver within three nautical miles, while Pakistan disputes this and asserts the incident occurred within its exclusive economic zone during a naval exercise.
items.summary: India rejected Pakistan's allegations concerning a collision between INS Kolkata and PNS Hunain in the Arabian Sea. MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that Pakistan's response was an attempt to hide the truth. India claims PNS Hunain violated a 1991 agreement by coming within three nautical miles. Pakistan disputes this, alleging the incident occurred within its exclusive economic zone during a naval exercise. Both nations have lodged diplomatic protests.
items.title: India Rejects Pakistan's Allegations Over Naval Collision

key_points: Tata Group stocks declined on September 18, 2026, following a boardroom dispute where Tata Trusts declared N. Chandrasekaran's reappointment as chairman illegal.
The conflict involves regulatory pressure from the RBI and a disagreement over governance, with Tata Trusts demanding unanimous nominee support and opposing a potential public listing of Tata Sons.
items.summary: Tata Group stocks fell on September 18, 2026, after Tata Trusts declared the reappointment of N. Chandrasekaran as chairman illegal, citing a violation of the Articles of Association. While the board voted 4-1 to extend his tenure, Tata Trusts insisted on unanimous nominee support. The dispute, highlighted by a legal opinion from former Chief Justice D.Y. Chandrachud, has created uncertainty regarding ownership control and a potential public listing of Tata Sons, prompting market volatility across various group entities.
items.title: Tata Group Stocks Slide Amid Boardroom Dispute Over Chairman Reappointment

key_points: Sanchita Dey Pradhan, the Trinamool Congress candidate for the Nandigram bypoll, withdrew her nomination on Friday.
Mamata Banerjee announced her party will support the Congress candidate in the upcoming election.
items.summary: In a development affecting the Trinamool Congress, candidate Sanchita Dey Pradhan withdrew her nomination for the Nandigram assembly bypoll on Friday. This withdrawal occurred just before the deadline, following a meeting with BJP leader Suvendu Adhikari. A viral photograph of the two together remains unverified. Mamata Banerjee, addressing a press conference, stated her party would now support the Congress candidate, citing solidarity from Rahul Gandhi and Arvind Kejriwal against the BJP.
items.title: TMC Candidate Withdraws Nandigram Nominations Following Meeting with Suvendu Adhikari

key_points: Alibaba's Qwen team released Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash, an omni-modal model accepting text, images, audio, and video to return text outputs.
The model features a 1M-token context window and is available as a hosted API on QwenCloud without open weights.
Agentic perception capabilities improved OmniVideoBench accuracy from 63.4 to 67.8 while reducing token usage by approximately 45.7%.
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team has released Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash, its first omni-modal model designed around agentic capabilities for understanding text, images, audio, and video. The model is currently available as a hosted API on QwenCloud, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, and Qwen Studio, though no open weights were announced at launch. It operates with a 1M-token context window and supports functions like web search and tool use. According to the research team, agentic perception features improved accuracy on the OmniVideoBench benchmark from 63.4 to 67.8, while reducing token consumption by approximately 45.7%. The model is priced at $0.15 per 1M input tokens and $0.47 per 1M output tokens on QwenCloud.
items.title: Alibaba Qwen Releases New Omni-Modal AI Model with Agentic Capabilities

key_points: The forum, attended by nearly 2,000 representatives from over 100 countries, emphasized multilateralism and the Global Governance Initiative proposed by China in 2025.
items.summary: Chinese Minister of National Defense Dong Jun called for joint efforts to address common security challenges as the 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum concluded. The event, held in Beijing from September 14, 2026, gathered nearly 2,000 representatives from over 100 countries. Dong emphasized that deeper cooperation ensures a safer world and pledged China's military contribution to global stability. Participants discussed multilateralism and the Global Governance Initiative, with experts noting China's policy upholds the UN-centered international order.
items.title: Chinese Defense Minister Calls for Joint Global Security Efforts at Beijing Forum

key_points: Chinese Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang called for building a higher-level China-ASEAN Free Trade Area during the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo in Nanning on September 17, 2026.
items.summary: Chinese Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang called for efforts to build a higher-level China-ASEAN Free Trade Area (CAFTA) at the opening ceremony of the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo in Nanning on September 17, 2026. Ding stated that implementing the CAFTA 3.0 Upgrade Protocol will inject new momentum into regional economic development. He urged deeper cooperation in emerging areas, including the digital economy and artificial intelligence, to foster new engines for high-quality regional economic development. Ding also emphasized strengthening connectivity and upgrading trade and investment cooperation between China and ASEAN.
items.title: Vice Premier Ding Calls for Higher-Level China-ASEAN Free Trade Area

key_points: Five abandoned baby orangutans in Odisha have highlighted a growing international trade in exotic primates, with India increasingly seen as a destination.
Seizures in 2022 included over 100 primates among nearly 4,000 exotic animals, with gibbons and orangutans appearing prominently in interceptions at airports and borders.
Conservationists warn that obtaining young primates often involves killing mothers and that the animals suffer severe trauma during transport and separation.
items.summary: Five baby orangutans found abandoned in Odisha have opened a window into a growing international trade in primates, raising questions about India's role. Authorities are investigating the antecedents of these critically endangered animals as India emerges as a link in the trade. In 2022, more than 100 primates were among nearly 4,000 exotic animals seized in India across 56 incidents. Conservationists note that obtaining young orangutans often involves killing the mother, and the violent transport and separation cause severe welfare issues. While repatriation to Indonesia is an option, Indian authorities are delaying DNA testing due to the infants' delicate health. Experts emphasize that the trade targets wild-caught animals, and the loss of breeding adults has long-term consequences for slow-reproducing species.
items.title: India Emerges as Hub for Illegal Primate Trade Amid Welfare Concerns

key_points: China Energy Engineering Corp. launched a 15 GW solar module procurement program for 2026, covering TOPCon, HJT, and BC technologies.
Golden Solar New Energy Technology revised its 2026 fundraising plan to focus on an AI computing center and debt repayment amid financial strain.
items.summary: China Energy Engineering Corp. announced a 15 GW solar module procurement program for 2026, the largest centralized tender by a Chinese state-owned enterprise this year. Meanwhile, Golden Solar New Energy Technology revised its 2026 fundraising plan, proposing to raise up to CNY 2.39 billion, primarily for an AI computing center in Beijing's Tongzhou district and debt repayment, reflecting financial challenges in the sector.
items.title: Chinese State-Owned Enterprises Launch Solar Procurement and M&A Deals

key_points: Kerala Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala stated the state government is awaiting legal advice regarding an Enforcement Directorate letter seeking corruption cases against former Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan and others.
Chennithala defended police actions during a raid on Reporter TV, asserting no journalist was mistreated and the search was conducted with judicial warrants and independent witnesses present.
items.summary: Kerala Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala announced that the state government is currently awaiting legal advice concerning a communication from the Enforcement Directorate requesting the registration of corruption cases against former Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan, his daughter T. Veena, and P.A. Mohamed Riyas. Addressing a press conference in Thiruvananthapuram, Chennithala noted the government expects the legal opinion shortly before taking a decision. Separately, he defended police actions during a raid on Reporter TV, stating no journalist was mistreated and the search was videographed with independent witnesses present.
items.title: Kerala Home Minister Awaits Legal Advice on ED Corruption Case

key_points: The Tata Sons Board reappointed N. Chandrasekaran as Executive Chairman for five years starting February 2027 following a request from the Nomination & Remineralisation Committee.

Tata Trusts, holding a 66% stake, declared the reappointment illegal because their nominee director, Noel Tata, vetoed the resolution, citing Articles of Association requiring unanimous nominee approval.
Tata Trusts opposes the mandatory listing of Tata Sons urged by the RBI, arguing it would destroy the group's unique charitable structure, while the SP Group supports listing for transparency.
items.summary: The Tata Sons Board reappointed N. Chandrasekaran as Executive Chairman for a five-year term starting February 2027 after the Nomination & Remineralisation Committee requested him to reconsider his decision not to seek re-appointment. This move has sparked a conflict with Tata Trusts, the majority owner holding a 66% stake. Tata Trusts, through Chairman Noel Tata, declared the reappointment a legal nullity because their nominee director voted against it, arguing the Articles of Association require unanimous approval from nominee directors for such appointments. Separately, Tata Trusts opposes the Reserve Bank of India's directive regarding Tata Sons' Core Investment Company license, arguing mandatory listing would destroy the group's unique charitable structure. Conversely, the Shapoorji Pallonji Group supports listing for transparency and accountability.
items.title: Tata Sons Board Reappoints N. Chandrasekaran Amid Conflict with Tata Trusts

key_points: The Election Commission of India has assigned interim names and symbols to the two factions of the Trinamool Congress following a party split.
items.summary: The Election Commission of India has officially allocated interim names and symbols to the two factions of the Trinamool Congress following a split within the party. The faction led by Mamata Banerjee has been named Mamata All India Trinamool Congress, while the rebel faction led by Ritabrata Banerjee is designated as the Democratic Trinamool Congress. The original TMC name and symbol remain frozen pending a substantive determination by the commission. These temporary allocations will be used for the upcoming by-elections in West Bengal's Rajnagar and Nandigram constituencies scheduled for October 6. The split occurs amid ongoing legal battles and disqualification petitions.
items.title: Election Commission Allocates Interim Symbols to Split TMC Factions Ahead of West Bengal By-elections

key_points: While the government plans to refurbish it for helicopter and drone operations, critics question the $450 million financing and potential retrofitting costs of $900 million.
items.summary: Indonesia welcomed its first aircraft carrier, a 41-year-old former Italian Navy vessel, to modernize its military and enhance disaster response capabilities. The ship, renamed KRI Sriwijaya, will undergo refurbishment for helicopter and drone operations rather than fighter jets. President Prabowo Subianto stated the vessel will serve for 15 to 20 years. However, the acquisition has sparked debate over costs, with the finance ministry approving $450 million in financing while lawmaker TB Hasanuddin estimated retrofitting alone could cost about 16 trillion rupiah ($900 million). Experts caution that operational needs must outweigh expenses.
items.title: Indonesia Acquires Former Italian Aircraft Carrier Amid Cost Debates

key_points: The film features an all-women cast on a European holiday, a rare narrative in an industry often dominated by male-centric stories.
While the movie struggles with vague plotlines and inconsistent writing, it succeeds in portraying female sisterhood and the joys of finding a new family.
Critics note that the film fails to address internalised conservatism and patriarchy, and its conservative take on modern dating feels irrelevant to the times.
items.summary: A review of the Telugu film 'Happy Journey' describes it as a well-intentioned yet clumsy all-women holiday film. The story follows diverse women bonding over a European trip, a narrative rarity in an industry often functioning like an all-boys club. However, the film struggles to substantiate its characters effectively due to a vague tour plan and inconsistent writing. While the movie finds its groove after the intermission, allowing characters to bond through freewheeling conversations, it fails to address internalised conservatism and patriarchy. The review concludes that despite the filmmaker's success in portraying sisterhood, the wayward execution and inconsistent writing are a letdown.
items.title: Review of Telugu film Happy Journey highlights well-intentioned but clumsy execution
